## Activity

During December 2020, Oakridge Primary Care completed 27 captures. The activity recorded for the month provides a clear basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. No change to the site’s routine capture process was reported in the information provided.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. The ungradable rate was 3.7, with 1 capture recorded as ungradable. This result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

The grading outcome included 5 referable results. The median lag for grading was 2, providing the measure used to review the timeliness of the process. These results should be considered alongside the activity and image quality findings when the site’s performance is reviewed. Ongoing monitoring will support identification of any changes in referral levels, image quality, or grading turnaround at Oakridge Primary Care.
